why: The general (non-semisimple, higher-genus) Virasoro conjecture remains open, but post-snapshot arXiv preprints prove it for new specific cases: the genus-one Virasoro conjecture for Fano complete intersections (arXiv:2608.29870) and the absolute Virasoro conjecture (following from proven Virasoro constraints) for smooth projective effective orbifold curves (arXiv:2609.01300, Sep 2026).

"Virasoro constraints" orbifold curves 2026 relative Gromov-Witten proof

found.title: Virasoro Constraints for Orbifold Curves
found.note: Preprint proving Virasoro constraints for relative GW theory of effective orbifold curves, with the absolute Jiang-Tseng Virasoro conjecture for such curves as a corollary; not read.
